text:
lee: Heads up, eu-central canary is reporting 5xx errors immediately after the helm apply. Not healthy.

deploy-bot: [alert] Release my-repo/myservice v4.0.2-canary failed healthcheck in eu-central (pods failing: myservice-7c9d8f). Probe failures: 4/10 in 90s. Annotations: overlay-merge=true, merged-by=automated-merge.
nina: Which overlays were merged? Any values diff?
lee: From the deploy log, merged overlays list: base -> regional -> feature-x -> staging-debug (oops).
reza: staging-debug in prod? That's our problem. What keys does it add?
lee: Quick snippet (from merged values):
```diff
@@
  logging:
    level: info
+  debug:
+    enableProfiler: true
+    httpPath: /debug/pprof
```

ops-oncall: profiler path would open internal endpoints via ingress, probably NGINX returning 502/504 depending on upstream.
ci-bot: Note: chart version used = 4.0.2-canary, image tag = sha-deadbeef (same as stable).
reza: Two remediation options: (A) rollback helm release to 4.0.1-stable (fast) OR (B) patch values to remove debug keys and release 4.0.2-hotfix (values-only) to preserve chart fixes. Change window ~15m.
nina: We should avoid rolling back chart because 4.0.2 contains a security label fix. Do hotfix values-only. Also pin the canary for eu-central while validating.
lee: I'll prepare hotfix values that strip debug.enableProfiler and debug.httpPath. Command I'll run:
```bash
helm upgrade --install myservice ./charts/myservice -f values.yaml -f hotfix-strip-debug.yaml --namespace prod-eu-central --set deployer=manual-hotfix
kubectl rollout status deployment/myservice -n prod-eu-central --timeout=120s
```

ops-oncall: Also add a temporary network ACL to block /debug/* from public if we see more traffic. But hotfix first.
ci-bot: Request: please attach a release-note short entry: "values(hotfix): remove staging-debug keys merged into prod overlay causing open profiler endpoints".
reza: I'll also add an immediate CI preflight: overlay-merge tool must reject overlays containing keys under top-level "debug" when target is prod. Opening PR #4580.
nina: Can you also add a lint rule forbidding overlay names that include "staging" when target env = prod? That would have caught this.
reza: Yep adding both (schema rule + name-block). PR will include unit test.
lee: Hotfix applied -> release 4.0.2-hotfix (values-only). Pods rotated and health probes are green. Smoke tests passing.
ops-oncall: Monitoring for 10m; keep pin on canary for 20m. If stable, unpin and proceed.
ci-bot: deploy-bot: set_pin request by @nina for myservice (eu-central) -> chart pinned to 4.0.1 until manual clear.
deploy-bot: Pin applied. Automated rollback not triggered due to manual pin.
lee: After 15m, metrics stable. I'll draft a short postmortem snippet and add the release-note line.
nina: Postmortem blurb: cause=staging-overlay-merged-into-prod; impact=eu-central canary 5xx; mitigation=values-only hotfix + deploy-bot overlay-name preflight. Owner=reza.
reza: PR #4580 opened with schema + overlay-name block, adding test.
ops-oncall: Once PR merges, let's backfill a short note in the runbook about verifying overlay lists before merges.
lee: TL;DR: hotfix applied, canary pinned/unpinned after validation, follow-ups: overlay-merge preflight + overlay-name lint + runbook update. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Pin cleared by @ops-oncall after successful validation window. (automated)
